iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 69. STABLE: Islamabad talks collapsed. US demands 20-year enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 years. Iran denies plan to transfer enriched uranium to US. Trump claims deal close - Iran contradicts. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. Polymarket: 41.5% enrichment deal by Apr 30. Second round talks expected Monday. IAEA DG Grossi urges strict verification. Probability 36%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 69. RISING: IRGC fully closed Strait of Hormuz Apr 18, firing on at least 3 commercial vessels including Indian-flagged tanker. Iran says Hormuz will NOT reopen until US ends blockade. Ceasefire expires Apr 22 in 3 DAYS. No second round of talks scheduled. Oil ~$97/bbl. India summoned Iran ambassador. Trump warns Iran not to blackmail. Former US diplomat says not much changed. Second round talks expected Monday. Probability 50%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 69. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire mostly holding, expires Apr 26. Trump invites Israel & Lebanon leaders to White House. Hezbollah NOT part of deal - remains armed. Israeli drone killed 1 in south Lebanon. UN SG condemned attack on peacekeepers. Hormuz closure complicates dynamics. Probability 17%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened Europe largest warhead plant (Lalahan), fuel plant, missile integration facilities Apr 7. Largest defense investment in Republic history ($3B). TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic entering mass production. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. Defense spending $27.34B. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. India summoned Iran ambassador after Indian vessel attacked in Hormuz. First India-Pakistan drone war in May 2025 (Operation Sindoor). India rejected US mediation claims. PM Sharif in Qatar mediating. Probability 7%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 71. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting expected. First of 64 F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Russian Ambassador confirms delivery timeline. Finnish professor warns Finland could be first target in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Russia reinforcing nuclear/Arctic assets. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 28%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: CBS reports China weighing supplying Iran advanced radar - major escalation if confirmed. China says military activities around Taiwan reasonable and justified. Philippines opened coast guard base on Thitu Island - China fired flares at Philippine aircraft. ISW/AEI: PRC infiltration into Taiwan documented. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun. Learning from Iran war tactics. US redeploying assets from Pacific to Middle East benefits China. Probability 39%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 67. STABLE: Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series Apr 6-8 including cluster-bomb warheads, 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer, ICBM engine test. 6th missile test of 2026. Cruise missile tests from new warship. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. No new nuclear test since Apr 14. Probability 10%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1172+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded across Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa, Dnipro. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - Baltic ports Primorsk (40% storage lost), Ust-Luga (30%), Crimea Feodosia destroyed. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. Russia warns Europe against funding Ukraine drone production. Russian hybrid war escalating in Europe. Probability 91%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Pakistan declared open war on Taliban - bombed Kabul. China actively mediating. Eid ceasefire collapsed. Border clashes ongoing. CSIS: crisis drifting from resolution. Probability 8%. Stable.
